Train Derailments in Assam and Kanpur Cause Coach Loss and Service Disruption

Four coaches of the Chauri Chaura Express went off the tracks in Kanpur, while the Kolkata‑Sairang Express derailed near Digaru station in Assam, with reports indicating five to six coaches and the engine leaving the rails; the incident disrupted Northeast Frontier Railway services, and sources variously reported several injuries and that all passengers were safe.
